text.p: These are significant stories in the Nigerian press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Emeka Anyaoku, secretary-general of the Commonwealth of Britain and its former colonies, tells British Broadcasting Corporation (BBC) radio that Nigeria has made demonstrable progress towards democratic rule.
- Armed robbers attack church in Nigeria's southern Delta State.

- Nine tanker loads of petrol, valued at 3.2 million naira, have been detained by security officials near the border with Benin. Security officials say fuel is being smuggled across the frontier at night.
- Christians in northern Nigeria warn the army and police against preferential recruitment of Moslems.
